items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Ida Cox, and everybody including Miss Ethel Waters... Miss Ida Cox, which she was on a recording

ctx.x: Leroy died by keeping his door unlocked and everybody could come to Leroy's house to have a good time and he never got any rest. Leroy Carr when he wrote the "Prison Bound Blues", you see, he had actually been in prison and he did things with Scrapper Blackwell. He was and a very handsome man/in those periods when you had what you call race records, he was the one for 3 years to keep America and to keep the whole world alive that there were black artists, because they had forgotten about Bessie Smith, Mamie…

Well, do you think that we should play some more of these, like the Dirty Dozen, "When the Sun Goes Down," "Hey Lordy Mama," "The Fives," "Oh Red" and "Dupree Blues". Which one of these do you think we should play?
